description: Defines a template class SynchronizeType for synchronization mechanisms, including locking, signaling, and message handling within the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: SynchronizeType
classes.description: A template class providing synchronization primitives including message loading, evaluation, locking, and signaling.

methods.name: Evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a new message, copies it if response is expected, and signals event.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads a response message and resets the event.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads a special value (~0) as response to indicate a specific state.

methods.name: Evaluate
methods.description: Checks if the response indicates a specific state and signals event.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a lock with a timeout, returns status.
